detail.longDescription: I like building small sites (plain HTML/CSS/JS) for friends for their small businesses with Claude. It's easy and rewarding. Then I host them on Cloudflare or Netlify with a custom domain, basically free. But then my friends want to update the text and swap pictures. They don't know GitHub or using ChatGpt with Github. Wix and Squarespace feel like overkill, and overpriced, for a few small edits a year. I couldn't find a solution I liked, so I built a proof of concept that edits the Website content visually and pushes the changes back to GitHub. My friends liked it. Now I'm trying to make it usable for more people (https://editany.page/, currently a waitlist only), so I'm definitely biased. I am open to scrap this and join an open source imitative. I just could not find anything easy to use. And I don't want complicated react builds, or a markdown to static website pipeline. I'd like to hear how you handle this. Background: I know to build complex React web apps. But for most small sites, plain HTML/CSS/JS is just enough, plus an external form.
